caption: (a) Corpus funnel for the six registered diseases: papers in the title/abstract corpus, with open full text (share of the corpus in brackets), eligible after full-text screening and extracted. HA20, the development disease, kept its pilot corpus and was not full-text screened. Open full text ranges from 13.7% (Tangier) to 53.1% (HA20) of the corpus; every eligible paper was extracted. (b) OMIM allelic variants recovered anywhere in the run (tiers 1+2), with Wilson 95% confidence intervals: 43 of 75 pooled (57.3%, 46.1-67.9), ranging from 2 of 19 (10.5%) for Tangier to 8 of 9 (88.9%) for HA20. Below, where OMIM's 84 source papers for these variants sit: 5 were extracted, 38 are in the corpus without an open copy, 38 were never returned by the searches and 3 were not in the corpus (screened unclear/other). Where the source paper was extracted, 8 of 14 allelic variants were recovered from it: literature coverage, not reading, is the binding constraint.
description: Two panels. (a) Horizontal grouped bars per registered disease (HA20, SSADH, Tangier, LAD-I, AxD, Danon): in corpus, open full text with share, eligible after full-text screening (HA20 not screened, pilot corpus), extracted; log 2.1.1. (b) Dot-and-whisker of OMIM allelic-variant recall anywhere in the run with Wilson 95% CI per disease and pooled 43/75 = 57.3% (46.1-67.9); below it a stacked bar of OMIM's 84 source papers: 5 extracted, 38 in corpus without an open copy, 38 never returned by the searches, 3 not in corpus (screened unclear/other); log 2.1.7. Okabe-Ito colours, extracted = green in both panels.
